unlisted_practices: Adopt epistemic humility in developing and using AI tools in pain medicine, on the part of both AI developers and clinicians.
Provide medical and engineering trainees with more comprehensive ethics education, including earlier and more prominent ethics instruction in non-philosophy disciplines.
Teach ethics through a virtue-based approach that combines didactic and practical instruction and has mentors model virtuous conduct, including epistemic humility.

Teach medical and engineering students to bolster self-trust in peers and in affected populations, and to recognize the limits of their own expertise and rely on the testimony of others, including patients.

screen.reason: This is a conceptual/philosophical commentary arguing for epistemic humility when deploying AI in pain assessment to avoid testimonial and epistemic injustice.
